text:
Marie: Heads up — CI alerted on a CVE in the shared base layer `redwood/base:2026-03-15` (glibc). tagging sec oncall @David. Need quick plan to rebuild and sign, and questions about RBAC for the build pipeline.
David: Looking. Do we have a mitigation window? can we hotpatch or must we rebuild image and push new tag? :rotating_light:
Jen: Hotpatching glibc in prod containers is risky. prefer rebuild & re-sign base. Also we should avoid manual apt installs in base image — that's drift.
Taylor: +1 rebuild. Also we hit permission error yesterday when build-bot tried to push signed images to prod-registry: "403: service account not authorized to write". We need a clear RBAC role for the signer.
Marie: Agreed. Proposal: create role `artifact.signer` with permissions: storage.objects.get/list, storage.objects.create, registry.image.sign. Only bound to `build-bot` and `canary-deployer` for rollout. Audit logs must record signer identity + cosign key id + image digest.
Jen: For KMS integration, can we use the existing HSM-wrapped key? I want the audit records to include KMS key version id (so we can trace which key signed what). Anyone seen issues with cosign + wrapped keys and our KMS audit schema?
David: Cosign with KMS is fine, but we need to ensure key access is via a short-lived credential. Suggest the build job requests a signed short-lived token from TOT (token service) that has kms:sign with a narrow condition.
Taylor: Also add a guardrail: PRs that change `base/Dockerfile` must require approvals from `eng-runtime` + `eng-security` and trigger an SBOM regen job. If SBOM shows added packages with CVEs, fail the PR automatically.
deploy-bot: CI job `base-image-build` failed 2/3 steps: sign step -> `cosign sign: permission denied`
Marie: Taylor can you paste the failing job snippet? we need to update the role binding and retry.
Taylor: snippet:
```
- name: Sign image
  run: |
    COSIGN_KEY=kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/base-sign-key
    cosign sign --key $COSIGN_KEY us.gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-15
```
Error: "rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller not authorized"
Jen: That matches the RBAC missing write on registry + kms:sign condition. We should: 1) add `artifact.signer` -> allow push/sign; 2) add kms:sign condition for `build-bot` service account; 3) add audit log filter to capture `cosign.sign` calls.
David: I'll open a short-lived RBAC change PR and schedule a canary push to `us.gcr.io/redwood/base:canary-2026-03-21`. Targeting a 30m canary then progressive rollout if green. If anything > 5% error, rollback and open incident.
Marie: Incident playbook snippet for this event (quick):
1) If canary >5% errors in 30m -> tag `redwood/base:rollback-<ts>` pointing to previous digest and notify #incidents.
2) Rotate cosign key if suspicious sign activity detected and revoke the problematic key version in KMS.
3) Postmortem required if >4h remediation time.
David: I'll take the RBAC PR. tagging @Jen for KMS audit schema updates.
Jen: I'll add the KMS key version id to our signing audit table and wire cosign output into Cloud Audit Logs via the short-lived token flow. Also adding SBOM checks into `ci/image-verify`.
Taylor: Once RBAC is live, I'll rerun the `base-image-build` job and push canary. I'll coordinate with infra for a 11:00 PST window.
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window 11:00-12:00 PST today. If the canary triggers incident, use oncall escalation matrix.
Marie: Thanks — action items: David (RBAC PR), Jen (KMS audit + SBOM rule), Taylor (rerun build + canary), I'll draft the rollback command and runbook. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
David: PR opened -> https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge_requests/5124 - contains role `artifact.signer` and a brief migration note.
Taylor: Re-run queued, will post results in ~10m.
deploy-bot: base-image-build (canary) succeeded for digest sha256:abc123... cosign verify ok (keyversion: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/base-sign-key/1)
Jen: Verified audit entry includes key version and signer principal. SBOM job passed. moving to staged rollout.
Marie: Good work team. Post-rollout please add a short entry to the image inventory with the new digest and ticket reference for traceability.
